clean_story:
Now I will teach you Dreams. When you close eyes, sometimes see moving pictures in head, like shadows on cave wall but no fire. Pictures can be of hunt, beast, or tribe, even if not there. Body stays still, but mind walks like spirit. Sometimes happy, sometimes scary, but not real. You wake, pictures gone. this is Dreams.

Discover sleep, spirit, sky.
